n1.text: Is the measured delta-T lower or higher than the target? (Calculate it in the Readings tab.)

n2.text: Are there open bypasses, over-pumped circuits, or three-way valves stuck in bypass?

r_exc.cause: Excess flow or a bypass is reducing delta-T.
fix: Check pump speed and balancing valve settings against the design flow.
Check three-way valve actuators and bypass lines.

n3.text: Is the load very light (few terminal units calling, mild weather)?

r_light.cause: Low delta-T from a light load.
fix: Re-check delta-T when more zones are calling or at a colder outdoor temperature.
Check reset and setpoints for the current weather (Readings tab).

r_ht.cause: Terminal units may not be transferring heat.
fix: Check coils, fins and fans for fouling or failure.
Check control valves are actually opening.
Check for air binding in terminal units and bleed per the system procedure.

n4.text: Is the pump running at the expected speed, with all isolation and zone valves open?

r_valves.cause: Flow is being reduced or blocked.
fix: Check pump speed setting, motor and coupling.
Open or replace closed or failed isolation and zone valves.

r_restrict.cause: Flow is restricted somewhere in the circuit.
fix: Clean strainers and check differential pressure across them.
Check balancing valves, air elimination and check valves.
Check for a partly closed or failed valve and for fouled heat exchangers.
